culpritSource.quote: The culprits are Satoshi Mizunuma and Tomomi Kashiyama. Originally, Mizunuma planned to hide the jack-o'-lanterns in his house. However, his son suddenly came to his house with some coworkers. He then decide to hide it in Kokubo's car along with the jack-o'-lantern balloons with Tomomi's help. Mizunuma removed three ballons so that the jack-o'-lanterns can be put inside. However, the wind blows away the balloons, which was later seen by Kajiyama and Kuwano as ghosts. The reason they also hid their own jack-o'-lanterns is that no suspicion would fall on passerby.
culpritSource.cleanNote: 原文 'The culprits are Satoshi Mizunuma and Tomomi Kashiyama.' 双凶手共同作案，保留两人

summary.en: Beika Shopping Centre is holding a jack-o'-lantern carving contest for halloween. One night, Kuwano and Kajiyama are walking home at night when they pass a road with jack-o'-lantern placed in front of the houses. Suddenly the wind blows strong, and three ghosts with jack-o'-lantern-shaped head appear.

victims.name: Tamie Kono, Tomomi Kashiyama, and Satoshi Mizunuma
victims.age: 50 years old (Kono), 29 years old (Kashiyama) & 60 years old (Mizunuma)
